s2:Counting the Unseen. II. Tidal Disruption Event Rates in Nearby Galaxies with RE

rationale: Papers 2602.06839, 2507.08082, and s2:Integral Field Spectroscopy of 13 Tidal Disruption Event Hosts from the Zwicky T provide new evidence on the relationship between TDE rates and host galaxy properties, such as morphological features and the presence of SMBH binaries, contributing to understanding the discrepancy in predicted versus observed TDE rates.
